description.value: The current-Save bonus rises to +2 and applies to Perception as well. The stale penalty does not improve, and never will — the higher you run on a connection, the worse the silence is when it stops.

cinderfall.incomplete: The current-Save bonus (raised to +2, extended to Perception) is built on Cinderfall's own Save/stale narrative-memory mechanic, which has no representation anywhere in the actor schema -- there is no baseline 'Save bonus' rule element for this card to modify.
